name: muia-static
description: Static recreation of https://muia.dia.fi.upm.es/ (Máster Universitario en Inteligencia Artificial, UPM). Content lives in data/*.json.

scripts.test: node scripts/build/build.mjs --quiet && node scripts/validation/check-links.mjs && playwright test
scripts.crawl: node scripts/crawl/crawl.mjs && node scripts/crawl/render.mjs && node scripts/crawl/assets.mjs
scripts.crawl:refresh: node scripts/crawl/crawl.mjs --refresh && node scripts/crawl/render.mjs --refresh && node scripts/crawl/assets.mjs --refresh
scripts.migrate:extract: node scripts/crawl/extract.mjs --force && node scripts/crawl/extract-site.mjs && node scripts/crawl/import-vendor.mjs
